_note: Probe, not the live app, and the reason is not convenience: components are
persisted per project by ComponentStorage, a fresh demo project has none,
and pressing ⇧A in the running editor opens the EMPTY panel (verified
2026-09-08). The four-row list this board draws has therefore never been
measurable in the app. The probe mounts the real ComponentsTab against a
fixture composer answering only the calls useComponentsState makes.
THE 'FROM BRAND' GROUP IS GONE FROM THE BOARD AND MUST NOT COME BACK.
The board used to draw a second section, 'FROM BRAND · NOT IMPLEMENTED',
with linked rows; it was hidden on the board 2026-09-07 and this spec's
copy[] now contains one group heading, YOUR COMPONENTS. That agrees with
the code, which ships exactly that one group and says at ComponentsTab
why: no brand→component link exists in the registry, so the section would
always be empty chrome.
